question: In 2023, who among the following individuals served as the governor of Telangana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamilisai Soundararajan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tamilisai Soundararajan** served as the governor of Telangana in 2023.
 
• She assumed office as the Governor of Telangana on September 8, 2019.
 
• Tamilisai Soundararajan is a physician-turned-politician and was the former President of the Tamil Nadu BJP.
 
• She is the second Governor of Telangana since the state was formed in 2014.
 
• As the Governor, she has overseen various state functions and has been involved in the state's administrative processes.
